newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia boosts internal coffee price to new high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia boosts internal coffee price to new high.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation raised the country's internal coffee price to a new, all-time high of 401,250 pesos per 125-kg load Friday in the 13th such price hike since Jan. 31, a federation spokesman said.

The new price was up 2.31 percent from 388,375 pesos per 125- kg load set on May 9 and was based on an average trading price of $2.39 per pound of Colombian coffee in New York over the last week, the spokesman said.
The internal price has been cut only twice since Jan. 31, when a new sliding-scale formula was introduced to calculate payments to Colombian growers based on world market prices.

The price serves as little more than a benchmark, however, since Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo announced Thursday that the federation had been authorized to pay growers any price necessary to supply itself with fresh coffee and meet its export commitments at times like the present when the country is being squeezed by an extremely tight supply situation.

Industry sources said Thursday that the federation, now competing on a more equal footing with private exporters, had been offering through its intermediaries to buy 125-kg loads for as much as 430,000 pesos per 125-kg load.
